Hi, thank you for reaching out, and we completely understand how concerning it can be to have your funds in a pending state. We're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

Withdrawals for verified customers are typically reviewed within 24 hours of submission, but delays can occur for a number of reasons — including enhanced checks, payment rail availability, or if the account is currently under review. We generally ask customers to allow up to 3 business days before contacting support, so we're glad you've reached out now that this threshold has been reached.

We're escalating your case to our payments operations team so they can investigate the specific reason for the delay on your account. In the meantime, please check your registered email inbox, as if any additional verification or action is required on your part, you would have received instructions there.

Please note that we're unable to guarantee a specific resolution time at this stage, but rest assured your case is being looked into as a priority. We'll be in touch as soon as we have an update for you.

Thank you for your patience, and we apologize again for the inconvenience.

final_triage.reasoning_summary: VIP customer has locked account with open positions at risk during security review. This combines account access restriction with potential financial exposure, requiring immediate specialist intervention to assess security status and position protection options.

final_response.response_text:
Thank you for reaching out, and we completely understand how concerning and urgent this situation feels — especially with open positions active on your account.

Your account has been temporarily restricted as part of a security review. This is a protective measure that may be triggered by unusual activity such as a new device, login location, or other account signals. It does not indicate that your account will be permanently closed, and it does not mean any wrongdoing on your part.

We want to reassure you on one important point: your open positions are maintained during a standard security review and will not be forcibly closed as a result of the restriction itself. However, please be aware that you remain responsible for managing your positions, including margin requirements — so if you have any concerns about specific trades, please ensure you have reviewed those independently.

Security reviews typically take 1–3 business days to complete. During this period, trading, deposits, and withdrawals will be unavailable on your account. Because you are a VIP customer and this involves an account restriction, your case is being treated as high priority.

We strongly recommend contacting our Trust & Safety team directly so they can look into your specific case and provide an update as quickly as possible. Please also check the email address associated with your account, as a notification about the restriction should have been sent there.

We sincerely apologise for the disruption and will do everything we can to resolve this as quickly as possible for you.

actions.description: Retrieve and review the security event log for this VIP customer's account to identify the specific trigger for the lock (e.g. unusual login location, new device, suspicious payment activity) and confirm whether the restriction was system-generated or manually applied.

Coordinate with trading_ops to obtain a snapshot of all open positions on this account, assess current margin status, and flag if any positions are approaching margin call thresholds that may require protective action during the restriction period.

Determine whether a supervised or partial account access exception can be granted to allow the VIP customer to manage or close open positions while the full security review is still in progress, subject to trust_and_safety sign-off.

If identity is verified and no active compromise is confirmed, expedite the security review conclusion and initiate account unlock via account_operations, ensuring the unlock is logged against this ticket with the security findings noted.

Once account status is confirmed (whether unlocked, further restricted, or under continued review), provide a direct case update to the customer via their registered contact channel with a clear timeline and next steps — do not rely solely on the initial drafted response.

final_triage.reasoning_summary: Customer is requesting trade reversal due to a self-made error resulting in a loss. Per policy, trade disputes must be submitted within 24 hours and outcomes are determined by trading operations only. Support must not promise reversal during initial contact.

final_response.response_text:
Thank you for reaching out, and we understand how frustrating it can be to close a trade at a loss — we're sorry to hear you're in this situation.

We want to be transparent with you: trade reversals are not something we're able to process at the initial support stage. Per our trade dispute process, if you believe your trade was executed incorrectly due to a platform error, you are able to submit a formal dispute for review. Please note that disputes must be submitted within 24 hours of the trade execution in order to be considered — late submissions will not be reviewed.

However, it's important to clarify that if the trade was closed as a result of your own decision — rather than a platform error — it would not qualify for a dispute review. Our trading operations team is the sole authority in determining the outcome of any dispute after investigation, and we are not able to promise trade reversal, credit, or compensation at this stage.

If you'd like to proceed with a formal dispute, please respond to this ticket with the trade details (trade ID, time of execution, and a description of what you believe went wrong) as soon as possible given the 24-hour window. Our trading operations team will then review your case.

We appreciate your patience and are here to help guide you through the process.

actions.description: Deliver the drafted customer response to the customer, informing them of the 24-hour dispute submission window and requesting trade ID, execution time, and description of the alleged error if they wish to proceed formally.

Monitor ticket for customer reply containing trade dispute details (trade ID, execution timestamp, and error description). If customer responds within the 24-hour window, validate that the submission is within the allowed timeframe before escalating to trading_ops. If the customer explicitly states the closure was their own decision rather than a platform error, close the dispute as ineligible per policy and notify customer.

Upon receiving valid dispute details from the customer (trade ID, time of execution, and error description submitted within the 24-hour window), conduct a formal trade dispute investigation to determine whether the trade closure was the result of a platform error. Customer is standard tier requesting reversal of a self-reported losing trade — assess whether any platform-side anomaly contributed to the execution. Do not communicate any outcome, reversal decision, or compensation promise to the customer until investigation is complete.

final_triage.reasoning_summary: Customer reports receiving an unsolicited password reset email, indicating potential unauthorized access attempt or account compromise. This requires immediate escalation to Trust and Safety for incident logging, account restriction assessment, and protective measures to prevent further unauthorized activity.

final_response.response_text:
Thank you for reaching out, and we completely understand why this would be concerning — an unexpected password reset email is something we take very seriously.

Here are the steps we strongly recommend you take right now:

1. **Reset your password immediately.** You can do this from the login page. Choose a strong, unique password that you haven't used elsewhere.
2. **Enable two-factor authentication (2FA)** if you haven't already. This adds an important layer of protection to your account.
3. **Do not share your password, PIN, or any one-time codes with anyone** — including support agents. We will never ask you for this information.

Please also contact our support team to formally report this incident. When you do, we will log the report and escalate it to our Trust and Safety team, who specialise in exactly these situations.

As a protective measure, your account may be temporarily restricted while a security review takes place. If that happens, you will be notified by email. A review of this kind typically takes 1–3 business days. During that time you would be unable to trade, deposit, or withdraw, but any open positions would be maintained.

Your security is our top priority, and we want to make sure your account is fully protected. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or concerns.

Check whether the customer has any open trading positions or pending withdrawals on the account. If a restriction is enacted, notify trading_ops to ensure open positions are maintained and no forced closure is triggered during the security review window.

Monitor the ticket for a customer reply confirming whether they have reset their password and enabled 2FA. If no confirmation is received within 4 hours, proactively follow up to ensure the customer has taken the recommended immediate protective steps.

Once the security review is complete (target: within 1–3 business days), communicate outcome to the customer, confirm whether any unauthorised access was confirmed, and advise on account restriction lift if applicable. Escalate findings to trust_and_safety leadership if a breach is confirmed.
